svg.title: One fraudulent transaction among a thousand
svg.desc: An array of 1,000 small squares, 40 across and 25 down, represents 1,000 card transactions. 999 are plain outlined squares for genuine payments; one is a large dark filled square with a heavy border for a fraudulent payment. Beside the array, notes explain that a model labelling everything genuine would be 99.9 per cent accurate yet catch nothing.
svg.text: At a fraud rate of 0.1%, one transaction in a thousand is fraud
Illustrative ratio; real fraud rates differ by country, channel and card type, and are often lower.
